https://danedwardes.com/why-you-were-a-b.title: Why You Were a Better Mover at Seven
https://danedwardes.com/why-you-were-a-b.d: Here's a provocation I regularly raise with people: the most physically literate version of you has probably already existed. It was you at age seven, scrambling up a tree, jumping off a wall, rolling down a hill for no reason other than the fact that rolling down hills is great fun. You weren't training; you weren't optimising - you were just playing.
